overclaims: Character.AI did enter bankruptcy before the cutoff, matching an important example in the forecast.
checks.note: The proposition leaves out the speaker's mechanism: the company 'collapsing under the weight of an unsustainable business model'. The rationale says the bankruptcy 'matches' the example, but the packet's own gaps say the causes (operating economics vs litigation) are unsettled. Also, the platform is only to be wound down if no buyer is found. e4's public excerpt 'wound down.' cuts the conditional ('If the process fails to produce a buyer...'), so it reads as if closure happened. Axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews. e5 and e6 are fine.
